item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
New
  • Auto-zoom on typing — automatically zooms toward the text caret as you type, tracked via the Accessibility API
  • Named cursor smoothing tiers — None / Smooth / Medium / Rapid, with anticipation + follow-through and magnetic click landing
  • Watermarked free export — unlicensed users can now export with an anti-crop moving watermark
  • Native appearance modes — light / dark / auto theme support
  • Custom aspect ratios for export
  • Database-backed library — content-addressed media storage with automatic migration from the old format
  • Edited-state thumbnails on the dashboard, with live refresh
  • Smart trim suggestion — uses cursor trajectory to suggest where to trim
  • Setapp distribution — available through the Setapp marketplace
Improved
  • Cursor motion — demo-grade defaults (click pulse, hide-when-still, output-aware sizing) and smoother trackpad reposition handling
  • New export engine — rebuilt on AVAssetWriter as the foundation for faster exports (currently behind a kill switch while it's validated)
  • Default export quality changed from High Quality to Original
  • Onboarding — rebuilt as a state machine; permissions collapsed to a single status screen
  • Secrets storage — license, auth, and API keys now stored securely in the macOS Keychain
  • Recorder reliability — disk-space preflight check and clearer capture-failure messages before recording
  • Auto-follow playhead during timeline playback
Fixed
  • Blur/pixelate not rendering until the slider was moved
  • Timeline scroll jumping during playback
  • Display thumbnail capture hanging the main thread
  • Blank lead-in frames at the start of fresh recordings
  • Several dead/non-functional inspector and dashboard controls
  • Dashboard not reopening when the editor window closes
  • Timeline timecode display
